zh.title: 空軍一號起飛前逃生梯意外開啟 部署美軍人員緊急處置
zh.summary: 美國空軍一號於安德魯斯聯合基地檢查時逃生梯誤開；人員移除後已起飛
body: 美國總統川普於2026年9月9日準備從安德魯斯聯合基地搭機前往達拉斯時，總統專機空軍一號在登機前意外開啟緊急逃生梯，導致行程短暫延誤。
該架波音747-8專機右前方的逃生梯，係由美國空軍機組人員於起飛前檢查過程中意外觸發。軍方人員隨後對飛機進行檢查，並將逃生梯洩氣後順利移除。
川普在處置期間於海軍陸戰隊一號直升機上等待，隨後順利登機並起飛前往德州。川普先前於2026年7月1日首次搭乘這架由卡達贈送的波音747專機。

en.title: Emergency Slide Accidental Deployment Delays Air Force One Departure at Joint Base Andrews
en.summary: Air Force One departure from Joint Base Andrews was delayed after an emergency slide accidentally deployed.
body: On September 9, 2026, US President Donald Trump’s departure from Joint Base Andrews to Dallas was briefly delayed after an emergency evacuation slide unexpectedly deployed from Air Force One prior to boarding.

The emergency slide on the front right side of the Boeing 747-8 was accidentally triggered by a member of the US Air Force crew during pre-flight checks. Military personnel subsequently inspected the aircraft, deflated the slide, and removed it from the plane.

President Trump waited aboard Marine One during the resolution process before boarding the aircraft, which then departed for Texas without further incident. The president took his first flight on the Qatar-gifted Boeing 747 on July 1, 2026.

zh.title: Frontier Airlines宣布首度開闢三條南美洲新航線
zh.summary: Frontier Airlines公佈首飛南美洲航線計畫，將開闢三條全新航線。
body: 根據 Simple Flying 於 2026 年 9 月 10 日的報導，航空公司 Frontier Airlines 宣布了其首度飛往南美洲的航班計畫。這是該航空公司歷史上首次將其航線網絡延伸至南美洲地區，標誌著該品牌在國際市場發展的重要里程碑。
在此次的航線擴展計畫中，Frontier Airlines 一共揭曉了三條飛往南美洲的全新航線。這項全新服務預計將提供旅客更多元化的出行選擇，並進一步開拓該公司在南美洲大陸的航空業務版圖。

en.title: Frontier Airlines Unveils First-Ever Flight Services and Three Routes to South America
en.summary: Frontier Airlines plans first-ever South America flights; carrier reveals three new routes.
body: According to a report published by Simple Flying on September 10, 2026, Frontier Airlines has unveiled plans for its first-ever flights to South America. This development represents a major expansion for the carrier, marking the very first time in its operational history that it will establish scheduled flight services connecting to the South American continent.

As part of this newly revealed international expansion plan, Frontier Airlines has disclosed three specific routes to the continent. The introduction of these upcoming flight services is expected to provide passengers with new travel options, while officially marking the airline's initial entry into the South American aviation market.

zh.title: 法國支持達梭VORTEX可重複使用太空飛機計劃
zh.summary: 馬克龍在巴黎太空峰會宣布支持達梭VORTEX；金額細節未公布
body: 法國總統馬克龍於2026年9月10日在巴黎舉辦的國際太空峰會上宣布，法國將支持達梭航空的VORTEX可重複使用太空飛機計劃。達梭航空聲明指出，官方愛麗舍宮文件同樣確認了法方對VORTEX的支持。
達梭航空將VORTEX描述為一系列可重複使用太空飛機，設計用於在軌道運作並以常規跑道著陸返回地球。公司設想其民用與軍用應用，包括貨物運送、自主軌道任務、在軌服務與干預，未來亦規劃載人運輸。
達梭擔任全球總架構師與整合商，開發工作與OHB合作進行，APCO Technologies、MT Aerospace、Sener、Sonaca及Space Cargo Unlimited亦已加入項目。達梭首席執行官特拉皮耶表示，法國支持將促使德國等國參與掌握太空機動能力。
VORTEX路線圖分四階段：VORTEX-D為三分之一尺寸飛行示範機，VORTEX-S為三分之二尺寸「智慧自由飛行器」，VORTEX-C為全尺寸貨運載具，VORTEX-M最終為全尺寸載人版本。VORTEX-D旨在降低高超音速再入構型風險並驗證關鍵技術。
此前2025年6月20日巴黎航展上，法國武裝部隊部與達梭簽署協議支持VORTEX-D開發，資金達3000萬歐元，為期三年。2025年4月9日特拉皮耶向法國國會防務委員會表示當時法國無太空飛機且關注度低，短短兩月後局勢轉變。
最新聲明與愛麗舍宮文件均未說明最新支持的金額、形式、期限，亦未確認是否有新增撥款。達梭另與歐洲太空總署簽署意向書，探討軌道載具合作及可能的亞軌道測試平台以減低技術風險。

en.title: France backs Dassault VORTEX reusable spaceplane program
en.summary: Macron announces French backing for Dassault VORTEX at Paris space summit; funding details undisclosed
body: French President Emmanuel Macron announced on 10 September 2026 at the International Space Summit in Paris that France will support Dassault Aviation’s VORTEX reusable spaceplane program. A statement from Dassault said an official Élysée document listing the summit’s announcements also confirms French support for VORTEX.

Dassault describes VORTEX as a family of reusable spaceplanes designed to operate in orbit and return to Earth for a conventional runway landing. The company envisages both civil and military uses, including cargo transport, autonomous orbital missions, in-orbit servicing and intervention, with crew transportation envisaged at a later stage.

Dassault acts as global architect and integrator, with development carried out in partnership with OHB. APCO Technologies, MT Aerospace, Sener, Sonaca and Space Cargo Unlimited have also joined the project, according to Dassault. CEO Éric Trappier said French backing should lead several countries, including Germany, to join the ambition for mastering mobility in space.

The VORTEX roadmap divides the program into four successive phases: VORTEX-D, a one-third-scale flight demonstrator; VORTEX-S, a two-thirds-scale ‘Smart Free Flyer’; VORTEX-C, a full-scale cargo vehicle; and VORTEX-M, a full-scale crewed version. VORTEX-D is intended to reduce risks associated with the vehicle’s configuration during hypersonic reentry and validate critical technologies.

The latest announcement follows a rapid increase in public backing. At the Paris Air Show on 20 June 2025, the French Ministry of Armed Forces and Dassault agreed to support VORTEX-D with €30 million over three years. On 9 April 2025, Trappier told the French National Assembly’s Defense Committee that France had no spaceplane and the concept attracted little interest.

Neither the Dassault statement nor the Élysée document specifies the amount, form or duration of the latest support, or whether fresh funding has been committed. Dassault also signed a Letter of Intent with the European Space Agency during the Paris Air Show to explore cooperation on orbital vehicles and a potential scaled-down suborbital VORTEX testbed.

zh.title: 波音和Anduril飛彈入圍美軍IFPC第二階段
zh.summary: 美國陸軍選波音進入IFPC第二階段；與Anduril合作
body: 美國陸軍已選定波音（Boeing）進入「綜合火力防護能力」（IFPC）增量2第二攔截器競賽的第二階段。
波音表示，這款中程飛彈旨在保護固定及前進作戰基地，防禦巡弋飛彈、軍事化無人機及相關空中威脅。
第二階段包括詳細設計、系統開發、整合與示範工作，以及驗證符合美國陸軍需求的競爭性能力示範。公司未公開合約金額或示範日期。
波音的攔截器結合自身尋標器技術、小型機身、Anduril固態火箭引擎，並採用模組化開放系統架構（MOSA），便於更換零件而無須重新設計整個武器。

en.title: US Army picks Boeing, Anduril interceptor for Phase 2 of IFPC air defense competition
body: The US Army has selected Boeing to advance to Phase 2 of the Integrated Fires Protection Capability (IFPC) Increment 2 Second Interceptor competition.
According to Boeing, the midrange missile is intended to protect fixed and forward operating bases from cruise missiles, militarized drones, and related aerial threats.

Phase 2 includes detailed design, system development, integration and demonstration work, as well as a competitive capability demonstration. The company has not disclosed the award value or a demonstration date.

Boeing highlighted that its interceptor combines the company’s seeker technology with a compact airframe, a solid rocket motor from Anduril Rocket Motor Systems, and a Modular Open Systems Architecture (MOSA).
